integrity: One claim only; no independence, external referee or historical uniqueness is asserted. State-occupation measures converge in distribution rather than in probability when multiple critical phases occur.
scientific_limitations: Finite reachable state spaces, all communicating-class diagonal blocks primitive, and maximal reachable Perron root strictly between zero and one.
No theorem for periodic blocks or countable-state processes.
Historical-priority uncertainty remains because the 2020 weighted-composition expansion might admit other unpublished distributional corollaries.
Exact verifier covers finite rational test families; the universal theorem depends on the analytical proof.
title: Dirichlet phase clocks and random quasi-ergodic measures on reducible finite-state survivors
